title: A 5760 by 3840 file in XAVC S-I 4K (AVC intra 4:2:2 10-bit) at 23.98p and 25p: encoder request, descriptors and profiles; one step on top of the 5760x3840 open-gate state
goes_with: the FX2 kit's real 5760x3840 open-gate state (dmmwb4688_fx2_v1, og57n_fx2_v1 or og57n880_fx2_v1, og57cp_fx2_v3 in coprocessor RAM; ogfile57r300m1_fx2_v4 or _v3 on the main processor), applied as one more level 19 step after it
encoder_cores: both (UseCore 2), as every reachable stock XAVC S-I 4K descriptor

memory.unit_type: 4 (intra above 8,847,360 pixels; the FX2's memory function 0x22dfa4 is the A7 IV's 0x2136c4, emulated in build/run_ogfile_emu_fx2.py)
memory.note: no memory-class site: row 4 is the 4K class's in stock; row 3 (long GOP) is not used by intra

rule_checked_against_sonys_s_i_profiles.rule: +0x4c = 1.5 x width and +0x56 = half the height in whole 16-row macroblock rows (rounded down), in every XAVC S-I profile
rule_checked_against_sonys_s_i_profiles.twins: 24 pairs (105xxx UseCore 2, 205xxx UseCore 0) that differ only in key, +0x34, +0x38/+0x3c and UseCore (none of them read by the matcher); the matcher reaches the 105xxx row first in every pair

while_applied: XAVC S-I 4K at 23.98p and 25p records 5760x3840; at 29.97p/50p/59.94p the request says 5760x3840 and finds no descriptor: refused at encoder open (do not use them)
XAVC S-I HD and every other format are not touched by this step
the picture bit budget is the menu's (240M at 24p, 250M at 25p): the same bits for a bigger picture
the MP4 headers say what the kit's encoder step makes them say for AVC 3840-wide formats (5760x3840 with ogfile57r300m1_fx2_v4; 3840x2160 with its --no-meta form); Sony's XML says 3840x2160
